marketAlerts.title: Every proforma re-pulled from the carriers, and every service now carries a full rotation
marketAlerts.text: All 21 services were refreshed from the operating carriers on the same day. Ocean Alliance came from COSCO (callPort and loopExport for AWE1, AWE2, AWE3, AWE4, AWE7, GME and GME2). Premier came from HMM service network loops EC1 to EC4, which publish an eastbound transit matrix. ZIM and MSC came from ZIM line schedules ZNS, Z7S, ZSL, ZCP and ZXB matched to MSC published sailings for the day counts. Gemini came from the Maersk routing API in PROFORMA mode across 27 lanes. AA7 came from the Wan Hai long-term CSV. Every service also gained a rotation block with the port order, terminal, weekday arrival and departure where the carrier publishes them, and a day offset from the first Asia load port.

marketAlerts.title: EC3 does still call Tianjin and Qingdao direct - yesterday alert was a false alarm
marketAlerts.text: The HMM proforma for EC3 lists Xingang/Tianjin and Qingdao as the first two calls on the rotation, with published transits of 57 and 54 days to New York. The transshipment rows the ONE Route Finder returned yesterday were a booking availability artefact, not a rotation change. Carrying the cells forward was the right call. No rotation edit is needed.

marketAlerts.title: ZIM line codes mapped to the profile service names
marketAlerts.text: ZIM publishes these strings under its own names: EMPIRE is ZIM North Star (ZNS), AMERICA is ZIM Seven Star Express (Z7S), LONE STAR is ZIM South Lotus (ZSL), AMBERJACK is ZIM Container Service Pacific (ZCP) and EMERALD is ZIM Xpress Boston (ZXB). The rotations match the profile. Two differences worth noting: ZIM lists Norfolk on AMERICA, which the profile us list does not, and ZIM lists Singapore as a load port on LONE STAR, which the profile asia list does not.

marketAlerts.title: Three rotation differences found against the carrier tables
marketAlerts.text: SAX/AWE4 calls Yangpu between Cai Mep and Hong Kong, which is not in the profile asia list. EC2 discharges at Halifax after New York and EC4 calls Kaohsiung after Panama on the return, neither of which is in the profile us list. None of these were added to the port grids this run because there is no sailing data behind them yet - they appear in the rotation box only.

marketAlerts.title: Where the day counts come from, service by service
marketAlerts.text: Ocean Alliance and Premier numbers are carrier proforma tables, published as transit matrices. Gemini numbers are medians of the Maersk proforma schedules. ZIM and MSC numbers are read off one published voyage per line rather than a proforma table, because neither carrier publishes a transit matrix for these strings - the rotation itself is carrier-published. AA7 remains a median across 15 published Wan Hai sailings. Each of these is recorded in proformaState so the basis is never in doubt.

marketAlerts.title: Haiphong sits in two rotations but was not on the sampled voyage
marketAlerts.text: ZIM lists Haiphong on both AMERICA (Z7S) and EMERALD (ZXB). The MSC voyages used for the day counts skipped it. Haiphong is shown in both rotation boxes with a day offset worked back from its stored transit, and flagged in the data as omitted on the sampled voyage.
